# hackbuild-motion

> hackbuild-motion is a set of ESM packages under @hackbuild for moving 3D characters on the web: springs and seeded noise, a humanoid bone mapper, inverse kinematics, procedural legged gait, clip retargeting with BVH and VMD readers, a runtime for a quadruped motion network, motion matching, gaze, blink and idle presence, avatar loading for VRM, GLB and FBX, a three.js stage host, lit scenes, lip sync, a GLB and clip baker, and Vue and custom element views. The cores are Rust compiled to wasm, three.js is a peer, model and weight files are never bundled and load from a URL or a file you give, and every package has a single file build that runs from file://.

Every package is ESM only with types included, installs from npm under @hackbuild, and is MIT. Each llms.md below lists the package's exports with signatures, minimal examples and the mistakes to avoid. Code: https://github.com/hackbuild/hackbuild-motion

## Packages

- [@hackbuild/avatar](https://hackbuild.github.io/hackbuild-motion/docs/avatar/llms.md): Load VRM, Mixamo, UAL, generic GLB, FBX and MMD characters into one humanoid space, with material repair, a wardrobe, expressions and a first person head hider.
- [@hackbuild/avatar-host](https://hackbuild.github.io/hackbuild-motion/docs/avatar-host/llms.md): Host a character on a three.js stage in any container, with a follow camera, the presence frame order and a loop that pauses when nobody can see it.
- [@hackbuild/bake](https://hackbuild.github.io/hackbuild-motion/docs/bake/llms.md): Optimize GLB models, bake animation clips into compact packs, and keep an asset lock with licences and hashes, in the browser, in Node or on the command line.
- [@hackbuild/environment](https://hackbuild.github.io/hackbuild-motion/docs/environment/llms.md): Light a three.js scene around a character with a key light, a rim light, image light and a set built from kit models.
- [@hackbuild/gait](https://hackbuild.github.io/hackbuild-motion/docs/gait/llms.md): Procedural locomotion for legged rigs: Froude gait choice, leg oscillators, footfall tables, posture springs, tail and ears, with a Rust core in wasm.
- [@hackbuild/ik](https://hackbuild.github.io/hackbuild-motion/docs/ik/llms.md): Inverse kinematics for characters on the web: two bone, FABRIK, CCD, clamped look at, finger curl and foot locking, with a Rust core in wasm.
- [@hackbuild/lipsync](https://hackbuild.github.io/hackbuild-motion/docs/lipsync/llms.md): Move a character's mouth from speech timings or the audio level, out to Oculus visemes, VRM vowels or ARKit blendshapes.
- [@hackbuild/motion-match](https://hackbuild.github.io/hackbuild-motion/docs/motion-match/llms.md): Motion matching over a clip database, with inertialized transitions, on a Rust core compiled to wasm.
- [@hackbuild/motion-net](https://hackbuild.github.io/hackbuild-motion/docs/motion-net/llms.md): Run the published quadruped categorical codebook matching network in the browser and drive a dog's gait from it.
- [@hackbuild/motion-views](https://hackbuild.github.io/hackbuild-motion/docs/motion-views/llms.md): Put a character stage, an avatar drop card and a clip strip on your page, drawn with the hackbuild-ui stylesheet, as custom elements or Vue components.
- [@hackbuild/organic](https://hackbuild.github.io/hackbuild-motion/docs/organic/llms.md): Critically damped springs, inertialization, seeded noise and samplers for procedural animation, with a Rust core in wasm.
- [@hackbuild/presence](https://hackbuild.github.io/hackbuild-motion/docs/presence/llms.md): Make a standing humanoid look present: gaze, blink, breath, idle moves, gestures, a layered clip player and a face driver.
- [@hackbuild/retarget](https://hackbuild.github.io/hackbuild-motion/docs/retarget/llms.md): Move clips between any rigs through one normalized humanoid space, with readers for BVH, VMD, VPD, VRMA and Unity text clips.
- [@hackbuild/rig](https://hackbuild.github.io/hackbuild-motion/docs/rig/llms.md): Bring any humanoid or legged skeleton into one normalized space: bone name mapping with no per rig table, limb chains, rest pose analysis, and the expression and viseme table.
